chars.DIRECTOR: a stern Moroccan school principal in his mid 50s, grey moustache, thin gold-rimmed glasses, slightly balding, wearing a dark brown suit jacket over a light blue shirt, no tie
chars.BOY: a lanky 17-year-old Moroccan boy with curly black hair, wearing a red hoodie with white drawstrings, black track pants and white sneakers

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: Night, a narrow old Moroccan derb street lit by a yellow street lamp. Seen from a few steps behind, head-to-waist: the DIRECTOR grips the BOY's arm and pulls him toward a dark corner, the DIRECTOR's face angry and visible, the BOY startled. An old white Mercedes with its door open behind them.

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: Close medium shot in the dark street corner: the DIRECTOR points a finger at the BOY's chest, leaning in, eyes furious behind his glasses; the BOY presses his back against a peeling wall, nervous.

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: Medium shot of the DIRECTOR under the street lamp, red-faced, one hand raised as he talks, the other hand on his forehead, shocked and humiliated expression.

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: The BOY raises both open palms in front of him defensively, eyebrows up, half-smiling nervously, talking fast; the DIRECTOR stands in front of him with crossed arms, stunned. Night street corner.

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: The BOY holds up three fingers toward the DIRECTOR, explaining with a cheeky confident face; the DIRECTOR's mouth falls open in disbelief. Yellow street lamp light, old derb walls.

scenes.name: n6.png
scenes.scene: The BOY taps his own chest with one hand, acting innocent and young; the DIRECTOR looks at him with narrowed eyes, jaw clenched. Night street.

scenes.name: n7.png
scenes.scene: The BOY puts a finger to his lips in a 'keep it quiet' gesture, glancing at a lit window above where a curious neighbour lady peeks out; the DIRECTOR glances up at the window, worried.

scenes.name: n8.png
scenes.scene: The BOY pats the DIRECTOR's shoulder with a reassuring cocky grin; the DIRECTOR stares at the hand on his shoulder, shaking with anger. Night derb street corner.

scenes.name: n9.png
scenes.scene: The DIRECTOR explodes, shouting with veins on his neck, grabbing the BOY's hoodie collar; the BOY leans back, eyes wide, frozen. Seen from the side, the white Mercedes headlights glowing behind them.
